# USGS 3DHP (National Map) fixtures

Recorded 2026-11-15 with `curl`, no key, `User-Agent: underbite-scout/0.1`. Files are the response
body of the URL on each line, unedited. Layer 50 is Flowline, layer 60 is Waterbody. Spaces in URLs
are sent percent-encoded. See `docs/providers/hydro.md`.

- `hydro-50-croton-envelope.json` — `https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DHP_all/MapServer/50/query?where=gnisidlabel%20IS%20NOT%20NULL&geometry=-73.87,41.20,-73.84,41.23&geometryType=esriGeometryEnvelope&inSR=4326&outSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&outFields=id3dhp,gnisidlabel,featuretypelabel,lengthkm,streamorder,levelpath,hydrosequence,uphydrosequence,dnhydrosequence,mainstemid&returnGeometry=true&geometryPrecision=5&f=json` (2026-11-15; 21 named flowlines with geometry (EPSG:4326))
- `hydro-50-croton-point-distance.json` — `https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DHP_all/MapServer/50/query?where=1=1&geometry=-73.86,41.23&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&inSR=4326&outSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&distance=500&units=esriSRUnit_Meter&outFields=id3dhp,gnisidlabel,featuretypelabel,lengthkm,streamorder,levelpath,hydrosequence,uphydrosequence,dnhydrosequence&returnGeometry=false&f=json` (2026-11-15; point with a 500 m search distance, 11 flowlines)
- `hydro-50-croton-levelpath-count.json` — `https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DHP_all/MapServer/50/query?where=levelpath=3767999&returnCountOnly=true&f=json` (2026-11-15; count for the Croton River level path (about 30 s))
- `hydro-50-croton-levelpath-stats.json` — `https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DHP_all/MapServer/50/query?where=levelpath=3767999&outStatistics=[{"statisticType":"sum","onStatisticField":"lengthkm","outStatisticFieldName":"km"},{"statisticType":"min","onStatisticField":"hydrosequence","outStatisticFieldName":"minhs"},{"statisticType":"max","onStatisticField":"hydrosequence","outStatisticFieldName":"maxhs"}]&f=json` (2026-11-15; sum of length and hydrosequence range of the level path (about 40 s))
- `hydro-50-croton-levelpath-3767999-attrs.json` — `https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DHP_all/MapServer/50/query?where=levelpath=3767999&outFields=id3dhp,gnisidlabel,featuretypelabel,lengthkm,streamorder,hydrosequence,uphydrosequence,dnhydrosequence&returnGeometry=false&orderByFields=hydrosequence ASC&f=json` (2026-11-15; all 138 reaches of the level path, no geometry (about 38 s))
- `hydro-50-croton-levelpath-3767999-first25km-geom.json` — `https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DHP_all/MapServer/50/query?where=levelpath=3767999 AND hydrosequence<=4815843&outFields=id3dhp,hydrosequence,uphydrosequence,dnhydrosequence,lengthkm&returnGeometry=true&outSR=4326&geometryPrecision=4&orderByFields=hydrosequence ASC&f=json` (2026-11-15; 47 reaches, 24.8 km, with geometry (about 40 s))
- `hydro-50-croton-flowdirection-flags.json` — `https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DHP_all/MapServer/50/query?where=gnisidlabel%20IS%20NOT%20NULL&geometry=-73.87,41.20,-73.84,41.23&geometryType=esriGeometryEnvelope&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&outFields=id3dhp,flowdirection,flowdirectionlabel,startflag,terminalflag,divergencelabel,pathlength,terminalpath,dnlevelpath,uplevelpath&returnGeometry=false&resultRecordCount=6&orderByFields=hydrosequence ASC&f=json` (2026-11-15; flow direction, flags and path length fields)
- `hydro-50-croton-paging-offset3-count3.json` — `https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DHP_all/MapServer/50/query?where=gnisidlabel%20IS%20NOT%20NULL&geometry=-73.87,41.20,-73.84,41.23&geometryType=esriGeometryEnvelope&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&outFields=id3dhp,hydrosequence&returnGeometry=false&orderByFields=hydrosequence ASC&resultOffset=3&resultRecordCount=3&f=json` (2026-11-15; page of 3 with `exceededTransferLimit: true`)
